messages:
Marta: quick FYI — staging link-check found a handful of 404s coming from the runbook under /kb/routing. I can open a tiny PR with relinks but want the doc owner to sign off before we merge to prod.

docs-scan-bot: Auto-scan report (id: 7631): 6 dead anchors detected in /kb/routing. Examples: /kb/routing/legacy-proxy, /kb/routing/load-shedding, /kb/routing/retry-policy#examples. Full list attached to the report.

Kevin: can you paste the exact paths here? if they're patterned we can do a single `sed`/`rg` pass.

Marta: list from the scan (shortened):
- /kb/routing/legacy-proxy -> 404
- /kb/routing/load-shedding -> 404
- /kb/routing/retry-policy#examples -> broken anchor
- /kb/routing/shortlink-xyz -> redirect -> 404
- /kb/routing/session-affinity#notes -> broken anchor
- /kb/routing/old-healthcheck -> 404
I opened a WIP branch: https://git.company/infra/branches/fix/relink-runbook-1745

Marta: proposed quickfix (local test flow):
```
git checkout -b fix/runbook-relinks
rg "(/kb/routing|old-path)" -l | xargs sed -i 's|/kb/routing/old-path|/kb/routing/new-path|g'
git add -A && git commit -m "fix: relink legacy routing paths and anchors"
```
(We'll run the link-checker after commit in CI)

Sam: @Marta I'll take ownership of this runbook and shepherd the PR across review. Please assign to me and @kevin for review. :thumbsup:

Olivia: quick note — we have localized copies under /es/ and /fr/ for some pages. Should we update those in the same PR or handle separately? localization owners might need to sign off.

Kevin: @Sam I'll pick this up first thing in the morning. If it's deterministic replacements and CI passes the link-checker we can fast-track the merge.

Leo: can we also add a short-term CDN redirect for the two most-hit legacy shortlinks? that'll avoid user-facing 404s while edits roll out. I can file the ops ticket.

Marta: good call @Leo — please file the ticket and CC me. I'll note the two highest-traffic paths from our analytics.

Sam: PR opened: https://git.company/infra/pull/4567 — title: "fix(docs): relink legacy routing paths + anchor fixes". Added a small test that runs the link-checker against staging and fails CI on any 4xx. Assigned reviewers: Sam (owner), Kevin. @Olivia tagging for localization awareness.

Kevin: :eyes: will review the PR tomorrow. If tests are green and the replacements are precise we can merge and monitor.

docs-scan-bot: Re-scan scheduled in ~3 hours after branch push. If report is green, consider merging during the low-traffic window.

Marta: thanks everyone. If you see any other stale anchors in that runbook, drop them here or put them on the PR as comments. I'll follow up with the ops redirect ticket and link it in the PR.

Sam: noted — I'll run a quick grep across localized folders and add any matches to the PR.

Kevin: perfect. cheers. :slightly_smiling_face:
